screen.sansmod.title: Abilities
ability.sansmod.dodge.desc: Dodges attacks automatically. You get tired after several in a row.
ability.sansmod.karma.desc: Your attacks leave damage over time (Wither).
ability.sansmod.bone_wall.desc: A row of bones rises from the ground in front of you.
ability.sansmod.blaster.desc: Summons a skull that charges and fires a beam.
ability.sansmod.blaster_rain.desc: Several skulls fire at the spot you look at.
ability.sansmod.telekinesis.desc: Lifts the target and slams it into the ground.
ability.sansmod.teleport.desc: Teleports you where you are looking.
ability.sansmod.eye.desc: Serious mode: more damage and speed for a while.
ability.sansmod.bad_time.desc: Slows nearby monsters, but you take more damage.
msg.sansmod.need_charm: You need the Sans Charm in your inventory.
msg.sansmod.bad_time: You are going to have a bad time.
